base_logic.regime: higher-timeframe directional persistence must be positive for long; conflicting/flat state returns NO_TRADE
base_logic.setup: entry timeframe experiences a controlled counter-trend retracement without invalidating higher-timeframe direction
base_logic.trigger: closed-bar resumption in higher-timeframe direction; order is queued and filled only at next-bar open
base_logic.invalidation: structure or volatility-normalized invalidation beyond the retracement thesis
base_logic.exit: base exit uses source-consistent trend failure or volatility-normalized stop; target/trailing variants are not combined in BASE
base_logic.cost_gate: projected conservative continuation must exceed all-in fee/slippage/funding hurdle

base_logic.regime: compression/range or emerging directional state; exhausted extension returns NO_TRADE
base_logic.setup: closed bar challenges a prior rolling channel/range boundary
base_logic.trigger: closed-bar boundary break with volatility expansion; fill only next-bar open
base_logic.invalidation: opposite breakout structure or volatility-normalized stop
base_logic.exit: base uses channel failure or time/volatility exit; fixed-target and trailing are later separate ablations
base_logic.cost_gate: expected continuation distance must exceed all-in cost hurdle

base_logic.regime: only non-trending/range regime; persistent directional decline or expansion returns NO_TRADE
base_logic.setup: price reaches a statistically/structurally defined range or volume boundary rather than fading mid-range
base_logic.trigger: closed-bar reclaim/rejection of boundary; next-bar-open fill
base_logic.invalidation: beyond boundary excursion with volatility-normalized risk
base_logic.exit: return toward conservative range reference; stalled reclaim can time-stop
base_logic.cost_gate: distance to conservative mean/range objective must exceed all-in cost hurdle

base_logic.universe: liquid crypto pairs only; pair formation and trading windows are separated
base_logic.relationship: cointegration or equivalent stationary-spread evidence must pass before signal generation
base_logic.setup: spread deviation is normalized by its own formation-window distribution
base_logic.trigger: deviation enters calibrated extreme and expected mean-reversion horizon is economically tradable
base_logic.invalidation: relationship breakdown, spread stop, or horizon timeout
base_logic.exit: spread re-enters neutral region or relationship invalidates
base_logic.cost_gate: expected spread convergence after both legs' fees/slippage/funding must remain positive

alpha_families.adapter_requirement: multi_asset_two_leg_replay; do not route through single-position legacy lane

routing_overlays.base_logic: time-of-day or quarter-hour state may permit/block an already valid alpha signal; it must never create a trade by itself
routing_overlays.incremental_use: tested only after a standalone BASE family has positive micro viability

held_families.reason: consensus matrix has only 2 direct alpha lineages and existing OHLCV replay lacks required order-book/trade-state inputs
